create_glm46v_config: create a Glm46VConfig instance for initializing a GLM-4.1V multimodal model with text and vision sub-configs
initialize_vision_config: initialize the vision_config from a dict or default glm4v_vision model type in Glm46VConfig
initialize_text_config: initialize the text_config from a dict or default glm4v_text model type in Glm46VConfig
configure_image_tokens: configure image start, end, and token IDs for multimodal GLM-4.6V input processing
configure_video_tokens: configure video start, end, and token IDs for multimodal GLM-4.6V video input processing
